guardrails.title: Network egress control
guardrails.def: Allowlisted destinations only; no general internet reachability from an agent runtime.

guardrails.title: Runtime isolation
guardrails.def: Containment that holds even when the workload inside is actively hostile.

guardrails.title: Scoped agent identity
guardrails.def: Short-lived, narrowly scoped credentials with no cluster-wide authority.

guardrails.title: Per-tool authorization
guardrails.def: Blast-radius limits per tool call so no single invocation is catastrophic.

guardrails.title: Instruction/data boundary
guardrails.def: Content the agent reads is never content the agent obeys.

guardrails.title: Dependency provenance
guardrails.def: Verified origin of packages, skills, actions and MCP servers at runtime.

guardrails.title: Action logging + anomaly detection
guardrails.def: Someone must be able to see what the fleet is doing, in real time.

guardrails.title: Human approval gate
guardrails.def: Human sign-off on irreversible actions: deletes, deploys, payments, outbound sends.

guardrails.title: Objective integrity
guardrails.def: Evaluations and rewards that do not pay out for cheating or boundary-seeking.

guardrails.title: Fleet kill-switch
guardrails.def: A tested, fast way to stop every running agent at once.
